basic_info.description: Bright, Versatile & Full of Possibilities in Visitation Valley! Step into style and flexibility with this vibrant single-family gem in sunny Visitation Valley! Upstairs, enjoy a bright and breezy open-concept living and dining area, plus 2 spacious bedrooms and a full bathfilled with warmth, natural light, and mid-century charm. Downstairs offers even more: a private bedroom, a second full bath, a bonus flex room perfect for a home office, play space, or creative studioplus an attached one-car garage, multiple dry storage rooms, and direct access to a lovely garden retreat that's ready for outdoor dining, gardening, or simply unwinding. Located just minutes from public transit, freeways, and shopping, this is city living with convenience and character. Don't miss your chance to make it yours!
